ROADMAP

Where we go next.

Plans, product development and assurance work share one roadmap. Each item keeps its source, intended outcome, ownership and evidence for completion.

Assurance inputs · Maturity profiles · Roadmap declarations (JSON)

How work moves

Triage → to do → in progress or blocked → verification → done or explicitly accepted. No owner or delivery date is invented. A finding is not automatically a bug; disappearance is not completion.

Closure needs a matching verification key, evidence, method, reviewer and date. Acceptance also needs a rationale. Source observations remain visible and do not change maturity levels when a workflow status changes.

Product plans and other work are declared in the corpus alongside the assurance adapter. Assurance findings seed the current queue; they do not define its scope. New plans need an ID, product, revision, next action and completion criteria.
